constraints: Change only Microsoft-hosted pool.vmImage labels. The macOS 14 schedule does not apply to self-hosted macOS 14 agents.
Move off macos-14 before the scheduled removal on 2026-11-02. The notice names macos-latest or macos-15.

steps.instructions: Change the reported pool.vmImage from macos-14 to macos-latest or macos-15 (see the replacement).
steps.title: Retarget the hosted image

steps.instructions: Update every other azure-pipelines.yml pool, including stage and job pools, that still pins macos-14. Leave self-hosted pool names unchanged.
steps.title: Align other Azure Pipelines pools

verification.purpose: Lint .gitlab-ci.yml with gitlab-ci-lint, or .circleci/config.yml with circleci config validate, when the repository has that file. Azure Pipelines has no equivalent local validator: queue the pipeline and confirm the job uses the replacement vmImage.

rule.summary: The macOS 14 Sonoma hosted image deprecation starts on 2026-07-06 and its scheduled removal is 2026-11-02, per Microsoft's hosted image deprecation schedule.
rule.title: Azure Pipelines macOS 14 Sonoma hosted image is scheduled for removal
